intention: Every device carries a console pane — the INFO+DEBUG diagnostic surface, projected from the bus info and debug channels, readable without waking the device.
why: child of every-device-has-a-presence: the parent's decomposition references this ticket
falsifier: RED if: (1) the console pane renders for a device that has never emitted to info or debug — it should show an honest empty with the reason, not a blank; (2) the console pane requires waking the device to read — it must read from the bus stored messages, not from the device; (3) info and debug messages are mixed without distinction — the operator must be able to tell which channel a line came from; (4) a record-channel message (announce, personal) appears in the console — digest refuses to collapse those, and a console that shows them has crossed the diagnostic/record boundary.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured — the chat window IS the measurement surface)
Law 4 (presence carried by BaseShim is physics, presence each device remembers to implement is policy)
Law 6 (the shim is the device's persistent front and process-manager — 'all of this is shim code stuff except the actual query processing' is an ownership ruling)
Law 7 (never-booted and offline are loud honest answers; a silent nothing is the violation; a bounce rides a RECORD channel so it never collapses)
watchme: none, because stub ticket at THINKME — watchme to be specified at /sorted
